summary: 6E dossier delivered per DOSSIER_TEMPLATE (all 7 sections, every claim tagged FACT/OBSERVED/POSTULATED/NOT_RUN). Descriptive statistics computed from legal raw per-contract daily data (20 6E contracts: 9 quarterly + 11 serial; RTH bars 08:30-16:00 CT, useRTH=true) with strict past/rolling windows; no PnL, no parameter selection, no scored runs. Primary-source checks: CME 6E product page via web-reader fallback (title 'Euro FX EUR/USD'; 'monthly and quarterly futures'; FX Quarterly Roll Analyzer tool), ECB Governing Council calendar, FOMC 2026 calendar, CFTC CoT schedule - URLs + access date 2026-10-02 in dossier; CME direct remains HTTP-403 (spec tables JS-render, not extractable) - specs evidenced via S1 machine identity (36+4 contracts uniform mult 125000 / minTick 5e-05) + NinjaTrader/AMP mirrors. KEY ENGINE-RELEVANT FINDING: the data lane's declared roll rule ('roll to next listed contract') is broken for 6E if applied literally - next listed after a quarterly is a thin SERIAL month (measured: Sep-2026 serial 6EV6 median 214 contracts/day vs quarterly 6EZ6 median 71,234 same 21 sessions, 333:1; IB's own S1 'front' = 6EV6) - the market front chain is QUARTERLY-ONLY (HMUZ). Even quarterly-only, the declared timing (last session before expiry month) rolls ~2 weeks early onto a thin book (4-7 sessions <10k/day per quarter); measured migration completes in the IMM expiry week itself (next quarterly >=50k/day on 2025-12-12, 2026-03-13, 2026-06-11, 2026-09-11 = 1-2 sessions before old expiry, 4/4 cycles). All 4 measured quarterly roll gaps positive (+82..+106 ticks = +0.35..0.46%/quarter, ann +1.4-1.8%, $512-663/contract) - CIP-consistent (USD>EUR short rates, POSTULATED mechanism, rates not in repo) - unadjusted chains embed these jumps. IMM expiry = 2nd exchange-business-day before 3rd Wednesday, holiday-shifted (MLK/Presidents' Day explain 6EF7 2027-01-15, 6EG7 2027-02-12, 6EF8 2028-01-14; 20/20 match with holidays modeled) - naive Mon-Fri arithmetic is wrong for Jan/Feb. Front-scale era (front >=10k/day): 2025-09-09..2026-10-01, 247 days, median front volume 65,869; daily ret std 0.333% (ann 5.3%), |ret| lag-1 autocorr 0.136. CRITICAL SESSION CAVEAT: all bars useRTH=true -> for an FX future the captured 08:30-16:00 CT window EXCLUDES Asia, the full London morning, ECB decisions (~07:15 CT) and the 8:30 ET US-data block (07:30 CT); only FOMC (13:00 CT) is in-window; hidden-session gap std 0.265% = ~79% of measured RTH-day return std; front-scale era is a single regime (EUR drift 1.20->1.13). Front BID/ASK close-proxy spread: median 1 tick ($6.25), p90 2 ticks ($12.50), 0 crossed days (247 front days); serial instead 3 ticks ($18.75) - reconciles S6_FRONT_SPREADS which used the expiry front.
findings: Declared roll rule 'next listed contract' lands 6E on serial (non-HMUZ) months with 2-4 orders of magnitude less volume (6EV6 median 214/day vs 6EZ6 71,234/day in Sep-2026; serial max observed 659/day). Engine MUST use next-QUARTERLY (HMUZ) roll targets for CME FX futures; nearest-expiry / IB-'front' symbol mapping is a dead-book trap (S1 front on 2026-10-02 = serial 6EV6).

Liquidity migration is quarterly->quarterly INSIDE the IMM expiry week (next quarterly >=50k/day 1-2 sessions before old expiry, 4/4 cycles 2025-12..2026-09); the declared timing (last session before expiry month) rolls ~2 weeks early, leaving 4-7 thin (<10k) sessions per quarter. Recommended engine default: quarterly-only + deterministic expiry-week calendar roll (A/B vs declared); volume-crossover roll not measurable in this snapshot (old contract files end at fetch boundary).

All 4 measured adjacent-quarterly roll gaps positive: +106/+102/+86/+82 ticks (+0.46/+0.43/+0.37/+0.35% of level per quarter; annualized +1.83/+1.73/+1.48/+1.42%; $662.50/$637.50/$537.50/$512.50 per contract). CIP mechanism (USD short rates > EUR) POSTULATED - rate series not in repo (FRED free pull flagged as next action). Unadjusted continuous series embed these jumps; back-adjust or exclude roll-boundary returns.

IMM expiry rule: last trade 09:16 CT, 2nd exchange-business-day before 3rd Wednesday of delivery month - shifts when MLK/Presidents' Day fall in the 2-day window (computed 20/20 with holidays: 6EF7 2027-01-15, 6EG7 2027-02-12, 6EF8 2028-01-14). Roll/expiry code must model exchange holidays, not Mon-Fri.

Session data is RTH-only (08:30-16:00 CT) even at M1: for 6E this excludes Asia + full London morning + ECB (~07:15 CT) + US 8:30-ET block (07:30 CT); only FOMC (13:00 CT) is in-window. The hidden-session gap (open vs prior close, spans all excluded sessions) has std 0.265% = ~79% of measured RTH-day return std (front-scale era, n=247). Any London/NY-overlap hypothesis from the FX-spot corpus is structurally NOT testable on this snapshot - flagged as POSTULATED transfer only.

Front-scale era for 6E starts 2025-09-09 (Sep-2025 IMM roll ramp of 6EZ5), n=247 days - slightly shorter than ES (fronts before Sep-2025 are beyond the expired-secdef wall; deeper chain is settlement-derived marks: full-chain ret std 0.446%/day, official marks usable as reference/signal prices, not fills).

Front (quarterly) close-proxy spread median 1.0 tick ($6.25) / p90 2.0 ticks ($12.50), 0 crossed days on 247 front days; the expiry-front serial trades 3.0 ticks ($18.75) median - reconciles S6_FRONT_SPREADS' 6E figure. IBKR commission document class $0.85/side + exchange + reg (6E-specific exchange fee NOT_FETCHED; only ES $2.24 example rendered); margins NinjaTrader $2,400/$2,640 vs AMP $2,310 maintenance (<4% apart); CME SPAN blocked.

Primary-source calendars verified 2026-10-02 with URLs: FOMC 8 meetings 2026 (federalreserve.gov; statement time not stated on page - tagged POSTULATED ~14:00 ET), ECB GC remaining 2026: Oct 28-29 (pc Oct 29), Dec 16-17 (pc Dec 17); latest past MPC press conference 2026-09-10 (ecb.europa.eu; announcement time-of-day not on fetched pages), CFTC CoT Friday 15:30 ET / prior-Tuesday positions (>=3-day PIT lag). BLS CPI/NFP schedules verified 2026-10-02 (sibling lane ES fetch, same task/date).
defects: None in own outputs. Inherited data limitations affecting 6E work (documented in FINAL_REPORT, restated for engine lane): expired-secdef wall ~1 year (true-volume quarterly front chain only ~13.5 months from 2025-09-09); deeper per-contract daily bars are settlement-derived (v=0, o=h=l=c) - reference/signal marks, NOT fill prices; intraday only ~30D hourly + 2D M1 per contract, all useRTH=true (no Globex overnight/London session anywhere in raw); no open-interest field in raw files.
